Tortilla Flats
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 4:13am

Ingredients




2 tablespoons Sugar
1 teaspoon Ground cinnamon
1 Wheat Flour tortilla, see *
Veg. oil, (for frying)
1 tablespoon Butter, melted
1 scoop vanilla ice cream Strawberries, sliced OR fresh 1 tablespoon Slivered almonds, toasted

Preparation

1 *Please note: Cornmeal tortillas CAN'T be substituted because they do not take on the texture of pastry when fried. 2 Combine sugar and cinnamon and reserve. Heat oil in a skillet and fry tortilla on both sides until golden brown and puffy. Drain on a paper towel. Brush tortilla with melted butter, and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. 3 Top with ice cream and garnish with fruit and nuts. 4 Serves 1. 5 Lawry's Calif. Center
